content.title: Genre Trailer | One Protagonist Escalates Across Scenes to a Title Card
content.summary: The same core character and a few relationship anchors are used throughout the multi-scene trailer: relationships are established first, then urban activities and private pressures are expanded, then the conflict is escalated to public danger and large-scale spectacle, and finally sealed with an independent title card; no reliance on untranscribed dialogue meanings.

quick_start.input_format: Fixed protagonist and relationship anchor + public world expansion + private vulnerable stage + physical danger upgrade + independent original title card
quick_start.recommended_input: Felt Botanist previews everything from greenhouse friendships, river market excursions and seed bank crises, to mechanical orchard rescue and glowing pollen outbreaks, before finally cutting to a standalone original wordless leaf emblem.
required_anchors: Introduce one protagonist and one relationship anchor before the location count expands.
Return to the protagonist while broadening public settings and group size.
Escalate from interpersonal pressure to visible public physical danger.
Separate the maximum spectacle from a held, original title lockup.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The same core character and a few relationship anchors are used throughout the multi-scene trailer: relationships are established first, then urban activities and private pressures are expanded, then the conflict is escalated to public danger and large-scale spectacle, and finally sealed with an independent title card; no reliance on untranscribed dialogue meanings.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A short trailer can escalate genre without dialogue evidence by repeatedly returning to one protagonist while broadening the world in five causal registers: relationship, public activity, private vulnerability, physical danger and maximum spectacle. A separate final title card closes the promise; recurring faces and objects, not unverified speech meaning, carry continuity.

invariants.rule: Introduce one protagonist and one relationship anchor before the location count expands.
invariants.purpose: Gives montage a human identity spine.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated opening faces create a generic clip reel.

invariants.rule: Return to the protagonist while broadening public settings and group size.
invariants.purpose: Expands genre scope without losing identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure location montage loses narrative ownership.

invariants.rule: Insert a quieter private or clinical vulnerability phase before action escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Constant action leaves no emotional pressure change.

invariants.rule: Escalate from interpersonal pressure to visible public physical danger.
invariants.ablation_failure: An arbitrary explosion has no dramatic ladder.

invariants.rule: Separate the maximum spectacle from a held, original title lockup.
invariants.purpose: Closes the trailer as a promise rather than an unresolved scene.
invariants.ablation_failure: No title closure makes the montage feel like an excerpt.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source taxi nightlife hospital and boxing montage
